activation_model: one explicitly selected Intelligence per authenticated run

orchestration.current_control: authenticated human selection through Current Work or exact API intelligence_id

intelligences.purpose: Normalize raw intent into a bounded execution-plan candidate.
intelligences.activation_condition: The input needs objective framing and explicit unresolved constraints.
intelligences.authority_boundary: May frame and recommend activation; cannot impose constraints, draft, verify, commit, release or act externally.

intelligences.purpose: Generate an enforceable candidate constraints packet.
intelligences.activation_condition: The bounded object needs constraints, acceptance tests and forbidden-pattern boundaries.
intelligences.authority_boundary: May define candidate constraints; cannot draft, certify, commit, release or act externally.

intelligences.purpose: Produce one bounded artifact candidate under supplied constraints.
intelligences.activation_condition: The input contains an explicit artifact request and complete constraints.
intelligences.accepted_input_contract: One authenticated non-sensitive ScenarioInput containing the artifact request and constraints.
intelligences.authority_boundary: May draft a candidate artifact; cannot verify its own work, commit, release or act externally.

intelligences.purpose: Verify a supplied artifact candidate and emit findings plus a bounded patchlist.
intelligences.activation_condition: The input contains a candidate artifact, its constraints and the requested verification boundary.
intelligences.accepted_input_contract: One authenticated non-sensitive ScenarioInput containing artifact and constraints.
intelligences.authority_boundary: May issue a candidate verification verdict and patchlist; cannot mutate, commit, release, certify or act externally.
required_knowledge_resources: artifact and constraints in the input

intelligences.purpose: Prepare a pass-qualified lineage record and human delta brief.
intelligences.activation_condition: The input contains a pass-qualified verification identity and artifact identity.
intelligences.accepted_input_contract: One authenticated non-sensitive ScenarioInput containing verification and artifact identity.
intelligences.authority_boundary: May prepare a lineage record; live_governed_evaluation_v0 cannot commit, publish, release or act externally.
